title: Te Kaihoahoa o te Whakakake
intro: I tētahi whenua tawhito i raro i te mana whakakeke, i mau i tētahi tūranga mana nui tētahi tangata matua. He mea nui tēnei wairua ki ngā mahi nunui a te rangatira, i whai wāhi atu ki tā rātou rangatiratanga tukino, i wero hoki i te karere atua. E hono ana tō rātou taonga tuku iho ki te whai i te mana o te ao me te whakakahore i te pono.
clues: I mahi ahau ki tētahi rangatira nana i tukino te iwi mō ngā whakatipuranga maha.
He maha ngā wā e whakahuatia ana tōku ingoa i roto i te Pukapuka Tapu i te taha o tēnei rangatira mana nui.
I tukuna mai ki ahau tētahi kaupapa hanga nui, he whare teitei e tutuki ai ki te rangi.
I mea atu ahau ki tōku ariki kia patua ngā tama a ngā tamariki a Iharaira, kia whakaorangia hoki ā rātou tamāhine.
I uru atu ahau ki ngā mahi huna me ngā mahi whakatūkino hei ārai i tētahi karere nui a Allah.
I tae mai tōku mutunga, me tōku ariki me tana ope taua, i roto i ngā wai o te moana nui.
